# source: https://github.com/veiset/poe.re/issues/414
# posted: 29/07/2026. Ctrl+Alt+C text as pasted by the reporter; only trailing spaces and runs of blank lines were trimmed
# note: magic, prefix + suffix, base name in the middle of the item name. The game shows "+4 to Level of all Chaos Spell Skill Gems" as Tier 1; the engine ranks it T4 because its (group, side) ladder IncreaseSpecificSocketedGemLevel|prefix interleaves the five element-specific gem-level families (STATUS.md VERIFY 7). Ranked by RePoE type it is T1. Kept as the real example of that flaw; the parser must fail loudly on it until the ladder rule changes.
# expect-error: TierMismatchError
